rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is out of the ordinary.

example.english: The arrangements for this wedding are truly unconventional.
example.traditional: 呢場婚禮嘅安排真係唔尋常。
example.jyutping: ne1 coeng4 fan1 lai5 ge3 on1 paai4 zan1 hai6 m4 cam4 soeng4

rows.note: Use this when an action, method, or idea does not follow accepted rules or conventions.

example.english: The way they handle complaints is really unconventional.
example.traditional: 佢用呢種方法處理投訴，實在唔合常規。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 ni1 zung2 fong1 faat3 cyu5 lei5 tau4 sou3 sat6 zoi6 m4 hap6 soeng4 kwai1

rows.note: Use this for a deliberately alternative style or approach, often with a mildly positive or approving tone.

example.english: The decor of this café is unconventional, but I quite like it.
example.traditional: 呢間咖啡店嘅裝修好另類，但我幾鍾意。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 ling6 leoi6 daan6 ngo5 gei2 zung1 ji3
